dimensions.assessment: Affects credit data resellers, consumer reporting agencies, and consumers whose credit reports are transmitted.
dimensions.evidence: resellers of information contained in consumer reports to follow reasonable procedures to assure maximum possible accuracy

dimensions.assessment: Sets a statutory duty of accuracy and provides a legal liability limitation for credit data resellers.
dimensions.evidence: No reseller may be held liable under this title if such reseller accurately communicates information obtained from another consumer reporting agency

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or revenue effects are stated.
Amends section 607 of the Fair Credit Reporting Act to establish new reseller duties and liability standards.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Fair Credit Reporting Act to require resellers of information contained in consumer reports to follow reasonable procedures

dimensions.assessment: Permanently alters the legal obligations and liability protections for credit data resellers under federal law.

missing_information: The exact number of operating credit resellers and affected consumers is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires consumer credit data resellers to follow reasonable procedures to ensure maximum possible accuracy before transmitting credit reports, while limiting reseller liability if they accurately communicate information from another agency.
